title: Settings and instructions: external instruction includes
status: integrated; independent review returned four confirmed findings, repaired in the follow-up commit
sourceBehaviour: t1 drops an import at depth > 0 that is not inside the working directory unless external includes are allowed, and its recursion stops at the dropped file.
V = includeExternal && (type !== 'User' || lCt()); lCt() is qE() !== 'local-agent', so local-agent mode gates user-level files too.
ir() passes hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesApproved into t1 and zae; the project tier computes includeExternal || approved.
IL(p) is containment in the working directory (Wd), judged on the resolved path.
Q6t lists skipped entries whose type is not User, that have a parent or linkedFrom, and are not IL; m9r is non-empty.
HXo asks once: false when approved or the warning was shown, otherwise it loads and asks when the list is non-empty.
Qcn persists the answer and the warning flag; the dialog lists the includes, focuses cancel, and a yes covers later additions.
hostAdaptations: approveExternalIncludes is a user-layer-only boolean, the same shape as approveAllProjectMcpServers: refused from the project and local layers, must be boolean, removed from effective settings.
loadProjectConfig gates imports at depth > 0 whose resolved path leaves the workspace; appendInstruction and pinRuleImports share the gate, and the dropped file stops the walk.
loadChildInstructions applies the same containment test unless its caller passes approveExternalIncludes; rebaseChildInstructions forwards the parent config's switch.
The skipped set is reported as LoadedConfig.externalIncludes {path, parent}, deduplicated by path, filtered against the files the walk read, and the CLI prints one stderr line naming the switch.
SessionConfig carries the switch and the skipped set, so a reload replaces both and applyConfig prints the notice when the set changes.
hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesWarningShown is not ported: it only suppresses the dialog, and the host's durable answer is the switch.
loadPathInstructions already refuses every workspace escape with a named error and is unchanged (stricter than the gate).
zae's external rules-directory discovery has no host counterpart: listRules only descends into the given directory.
IL compares against the process working directory; the host compares against the resolved workspace root.

knownLimitations: There is no startup dialog: the host's user-level switch stands where the recovered product asks once, so a user who never sets it never reads external includes.
The warning-shown flag has no host consumer and is not persisted.
The gate compares against the workspace root, not the process working directory; the host loader owns the workspace boundary.
notPorted: zae's parent-directory rules discovery (no host counterpart)
the startup approval dialog component (e3n) and its provider (chunk-msy0wfrd.js 11)
boundaries: No account, subscription, OAuth or network feature; the gate reads local files only.
No recovered application entrypoint was executed; extracted bytes were read as inert data.
Model traffic only through the owned loopback SSE driver.
